project.name: Mood Studio V2
project.description: Hệ thống quản lý Studio áo cưới chuyên nghiệp - Version 2 redesign

tech_stack.api_pattern: Server Actions with withAuth() higher-order logic for atomic mutations

database_schema.summary: Core: contracts, contract_items, customers, leads. Support: printing_orders, inventory_reservations, inventory_items, contract_notes (NEW), transaction_categories, studio_info, labs.

design_system.description: Earth-tone luxury palette — Stripe-inspired, Apple HIG compliant

btn_architecture.note: All btn variants inherit base styles via CSS grouped selector. TSX can use btn-primary alone or btn btn-primary — both work.

components.UnifiedModal: Standard modal wrapper for all CRUD forms
components.ScrollContainer: Context-based scroll tracking for elements inside overflow-hidden roots
components.StatusSelect: Interactive status dropdown with color-coded logic
components.SegmentedControl: Apple-style tabs for drawer navigation and filtered views
components.HeaderSlotsContext: Context-based header slot system — child pages override mobile header content (leftSlot, titleOverride, rightSlot, hideSearch) via useSetHeaderSlots hook

header_architecture.pattern: Merge order: props > context > defaults. rightSlot + titleOverride = mobile-only. Desktop keeps module defaults.

gotchas: TW4 scans ALL files including .md — use @source not to exclude non-code dirs
TW4 syntax: rounded-[var(--token)] is WRONG → use rounded-sm/md/lg/xl directly
CSS btn variants must include base styles — dont rely on .btn being present
Header detail pages: use HeaderSlotsContext to set mobile header slots — NOT separate <header> blocks
rightSlot replaces mobile actions only — desktop always keeps Search+ThemeToggle+Bell defaults

decisions.decision: Compact Create Header: breadcrumb > title+desc block on desktop.
decisions.reason: Saves vertical space and reduces redundancy.

decisions.decision: All mutations MUST go through Server Actions (withAuth). No direct client-side Supabase writes in V2 detail components.
decisions.reason: Security, atomic transactions, and better SSR/Server Component alignment.

decisions.decision: Use ScrollContainerContext for all scroll-based logic instead of window.scrollY.
decisions.reason: AppShell root is overflow-hidden, window.scrollY is always 0.

decisions.decision: header.tsx = SSOT for all pages. Detail pages use HeaderSlotsContext to set mobile-only overrides (Back+title+actions).
decisions.reason: Eliminates duplicate mobile headers. Single component controls height, shadow, z-index tokens. Context pattern avoids prop drilling.
